concept: MLX KV Cache Quantization and Zero-Copy Pointer Passing
summary: Source-anchored research for MLX KV Cache Quantization and Zero-Copy Pointer Passing. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Quantizing KV cache tensors to 4-bit or 8-bit in MLX reduces context memory growth from ~9.0 GB to ~2.5 GB at 64k tokens on 35B parameter models with negligible loss in retrieval recall. (high confidence)
MLX allocates tensor buffers directly into unified memory pages mapped with shared CPU-GPU storage modes, eliminating DMA transfers and serialization overhead. (high confidence)
